human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Turn currently scattered validator, Playwright, diagnostics, source-context, console/network, and requirement-level results into a stable ValidationEvidence model that can be compared across repair rounds. Reuse existing evidence producers wherever possible; this pack is about normalization and preservation, not rewriting validators.
human_pressure.goal: Make validation output machine-readable enough to support progress/frontier calculation and next-action decisions.
non_goals: Do not add a convergence controller yet.
Do not replace existing Playwright/validator execution.
Do not invent evidence that the current runtime cannot observe.
red_lines: Existing validator behavior must remain backward compatible.
Missing observations must be explicit null/unknown values, never guessed.

machine_core.goal: Introduce a normalized ValidationEvidence representation and adapters from existing validation/diagnostic outputs, with regression tests.
acceptance: ValidationEvidence can represent requirement/test identity, outcome, passed steps when available, failed step when available, expected/observed values, diagnostics, and source/evidence references without fabricating unavailable fields.
Existing PASS, FAIL, and NOT_RUN aggregation semantics remain unchanged.
Adapters preserve current validator evidence while exposing a stable cross-round representation.
At least one test covers rich evidence and one covers sparse evidence where only FAIL plus limited diagnostics are available.
Documentation states exactly which evidence fields ARC/Playwright currently provides and which remain unavailable.
invariants: No validation result may become more optimistic because of normalization.
NOT_RUN must never be converted into PASS or repairable FAIL merely to simplify the model.
Existing diagnostics remain available to downstream repair logic.

must_check: Evidence is normalized without changing validation truth.
Sparse and rich evidence paths are both tested.
The resulting representation is suitable for cross-round comparison.
reject_if: The pack rewrites the validator instead of adapting existing outputs.
